page_title: CHE 1-0 MNU | Chelsea v Manchester Utd 16/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+9' 7:2 – the corner kicks stats.
90+6' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
90+5' That's a clear yellow card. Cole Palmer (Chelsea) goes into the book.
90+5' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) works the corner short.
90+3' Ayden Heaven (Manchester United) takes out his opponent with a nasty challenge and is relieved when the referee only gives him a booking.
90+1' Enzo Maresca has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Malo Gusto (Chelsea) replacing Pedro Neto.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
89' Ayden Heaven (Manchester United) jumps into a tackle and Chris Kavanagh signals a foul.
88' Neat passing move from Manchester Utd in order to create new attacking opportunities.
87' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes the corner with a short pass.

84' Chelsea players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass. The linesman signals a throw-in for Manchester Utd.
82' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. It's a throw-in for Chelsea.
81' Substitution. Romeo Lavia (Chelsea) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Tyrique George walks off.
81' Luke Shaw comes off the pitch to be replaced by Ayden Heaven (Manchester United).
81' Ruben Amorim prepares a substitution. Bruno Fernandes is replaced by Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United).
80' Robert Sanchez leaps to intercept the corner kick from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United).
79' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his shot to the right post is smartly dealt with by Robert Sanchez.

79' Great solo effort by Pedro Neto (Chelsea) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save.
77' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) commits a rough challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul.
77' Nice passing game by Manchester Utd. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.

74' Chance! Noni Madueke (Chelsea) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Cole Palmer, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
71' 1 - 0 Reece James crosses the ball into the box. Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) gets onto the scoresheet by sweetly powering a header into the top right corner – 1:0.
70' Ruben Amorim has decided to make a change. Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) replaces Casemiro.
70' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Mason Mount walks off the pitch to be replaced by Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United).
69' It's like he was asking for a caution. Amad Diallo (Manchester United) receives a yellow card.
68' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 8:8.
65' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) was quite harsh and Chris Kavanagh didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
63' The Chelsea players are stunned as referee Chris Kavanagh changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
62' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Chelsea as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
62' Andre Onana (Manchester United) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Chelsea are about to take a penalty!
60' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

56' That's a well-taken pass by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
53' Big chance! A simple pass from Amad Diallo left Mason Mount (Manchester United) with just the keeper to beat inside the box, but his shot went agonisingly just past the left post.
51' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:0.
49' Reece James (Chelsea) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
47' What was Casemiro (Manchester United) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' The resulting corner from Pedro Neto (Chelsea) is cleared.
45+4' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
45+3' A raking crossfield pass from Cole Palmer (Chelsea) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
45+1' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar.
45+1' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Andre Onana sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the right post.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' Reece James (Chelsea) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
44' The injury to Reece James (Chelsea) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
42' Reece James (Chelsea) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
42' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) attempts to feed Noni Madueke with a chip pass, but Andre Onana reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.

40' Manchester Utd players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd will take a throw-in.
39' The Chelsea players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
36' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) sends a cross into the box, but Andre Onana comes off his line to gather the ball.
36' The Chelsea players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

35' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Chris Kavanagh with no other option than to blow for a foul.
34' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
33' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
32' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Andre Onana, who smothers the ball.
31' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Chris Kavanagh had an easy-decision to make.
30' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) picks out Marc Cucurella with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
28' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
28' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) unleashes a shot from long range but it's well blocked.
27' The Chelsea players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
26' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is penalised for holding. Chris Kavanagh signals a set piece.
25' Reece James (Chelsea) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the left post!
22' A precise low pass is received by Mason Mount (Manchester United), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the right post.
21' The ball possession is 37:63.
18' Chelsea are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.
17' Celebrations are cut short for Manchester Utd as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
17' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Manchester Utd players aren’t happy.
16' It's in the back of the net! Bruno Fernandes plays it into the box, and Harry Maguire (Manchester United) gets on the end of the cross to put it inside the left post. 0:1.
15' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
15' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

13' Chelsea players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass. The ball is behind the touchline and Manchester Utd will take a throw-in.
12' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle and it's Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Chelsea have a free kick.
11' Tyrique George (Chelsea) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Manchester Utd are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
8' The Manchester Utd players are exchanging some short passes.
7' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Robert Sanchez intercepts the ball.
5' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) is afforded space inside the box after collecting a pass, but the chance is wasted as his shot goes harmlessly over the crossbar.
3' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Mason Mount, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
3' A spell of possession for Chelsea in an attempt to control the game.
1' The first half has just begun.
Manchester Utd will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Chris Kavanagh.
